scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:react && npm run build:electron
scripts.build: npm run build:react && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:all: npm run build:react && npm run build:electron && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:react
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "backend,react,electron" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.clean: node -e "['desktop/react/dist', 'desktop/electron/dist', 'desktop/electron/renderer', 'backend/dist'].forEach(p => require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
